findings.finding: Terminal capex is a residual solved from assumed g/ROIC. Positive capex and algebraic reinvestment identity do not validate physical software replacement, contract acquisition or franchise development spending.
findings.impact: Terminal is 69.5% of central EV; valuation is diagnostic rather than a calibrated canonical value.
findings.remediation: Build independently anchored software/capex, contract-cost and franchise-development cash schedules before deriving terminal incremental ROIC.

findings.location: documento fuente citado Note 3 and cash flows; documento fuente citado capitalized contract costs; model.py delta_wc
findings.finding: Capitalized contract assets rise 68 to 76 to 84 to 87 across FY23/FY24/FY25/Sep26. Model aggregates all working capital and contract acquisition in 10% of revenue growth, with no gross additions/amortization/FX/write-off roll-forward or allocation to D&A and capex. Contract additions cannot be inferred as only the net asset increase.
findings.impact: Cannot establish completeness or absence of double counting for contract reinvestment; $10m flat annual stress is illustrative, not an evidence-based upper bound.
findings.remediation: Reconcile additions, amortization classification and working-capital inclusion, identifying overlap with existing D&A, software capex and development notes.

findings.location: report CFO normalization; documento fuente citado marketing disclosure and Note 9; model.py total-sales ratios
findings.finding: Marketing profit timing is neutralized and restricted cash is excluded correctly, but marketing cash working capital and allocation of development-note amortization/payments are not separately reconciled. Q3 9M cash-flow amortization26 versus segment adjustment25 flags an allocation difference. All-company D&A/notes ratios are applied after removal of marketing profit.
findings.impact: The 360.56 cash-flow proxy and 344.46 normalized reference differ by16.10 without a sourced itemized bridge; cash calibration is unresolved, not proven wrong by16.10.
findings.remediation: Reconcile marketing restricted obligations and collection/spend timing, allocate note amortization and cash payments, then tie normalized FCFF to GAAP cash flow.

findings.impact: +100bp WACC produces75.85, removing apparent margin. Retention uncertainty cannot be declared solved solely by conservative net-room growth.
findings.remediation: Preserve dated market evidence and reconcile gross openings, deletions, Revo and retention. Reassess marginal financing cost before action.
